# Lisbon 5-Day Trip Plan for 2 Adults

A balanced Lisbon itinerary for **2026-04-10 to 2026-04-14** with **history, local food, walking, and one beach day**, kept to **no more than 2 major activities per day** and designed for **short transit times**.
**Budget target:** about **€1,900 total excluding international flights**.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary

### Day 1 — Baixa, Chiado, and Old Lisbon Welcome
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, and do an easy walk through **Baixa** and **Rua Augusta**.
- **Afternoon:** Explore **Chiado** and **Carmo Convent**; keep it light and central.
- **Food:** Classic first-night dinner with **bacalhau** or grilled fish in Chiado.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **€220**
  - Lodging: €140
  - Food & drinks: €60
  - Local transport/cafés: €20

### Day 2 — Alfama, Castle Views, and Fado
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Wander **Alfama** on foot, including **Sé Cathedral** and viewpoint stops.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **São Jorge Castle** for the best historical panorama.
- **Food:** Dinner in Alfama, then a **Fado** evening if you want one cultural splurge.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **€280**
  - Lodging: €140
  - Entry fees: €40
  - Food & drinks: €80
  - Transit/taxis: €20

### Day 3 — Belém Landmarks and Pastry Stop
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/ticket-perforated.svg
- **Morning:** Go to **Belém** for **Jerónimos Monastery** and the riverside walk.
- **Afternoon:** See **Belém Tower** and the **Monument to the Discoveries**.
- **Food:** Stop for **pastéis de nata** at the famous pastry shop in Belém.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **€260**
  - Lodging: €140
  - Entry fees: €35
  - Food & drinks: €65
  - Transit: €20

### Day 4 — Relaxed Beach Day in Cascais
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Take the train to **Cascais** and settle into a slow beach day.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Morning:** Take the train to **Cascais** and settle into a slow beach day, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Afternoon:** Walk the waterfront, relax at the beach, and keep sightseeing minimal.
- **Food:** Casual seafood lunch and an easy seaside dinner back in Lisbon or Cascais.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **€240**
  - Lodging: €140
  - Train/local transport: €20
  - Food & drinks: €80

### Day 5 — Market, Neighborhood Walk, and Departure
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- **Morning:** Visit **Time Out Market** or a local market for a final food-focused stop.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/83/Lobster%2C_Time_Out_Market_Lisboa_%2850661858143%29.jpg Alt=Morning:** Visit **Time Out Market** or a local market for a final food-focused stop, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Afternoon:** Slow walk in **Príncipe Real** or **Mouraria** before departure.
- **Food:** Last lunch of petiscos or seafood before heading out.
- **Estimated cost for 2:** **€200**
  - Lodging: €140
  - Food & drinks: €50

## Cost Plan and Best Stay Area

### Budget Snapshot
| Day | Main Focus | Estimated Cost for 2 |
|---|---|---:|
| Apr 10 | Baixa + Chiado | €220 |
| Apr 11 | Alfama + Fado | €280 |
| Apr 12 | Belém | €260 |
| Apr 13 | Cascais beach day | €240 |
| Apr 14 | Market + departure | €200 |
| Total | 5 days | **€1,200** |

**Practical stay recommendation:** **Baixa/Chiado**
- Best for **minimal transit time**
- Easy walking access to **historic center, restaurants, and transit**
- Good base for both **Alfama** and **Belém** day trips

**Why this works for your budget:**
- Your planned spend is around **€1,200**
- That leaves about **€700 buffer** for a nicer hotel, extra meals, fado, taxis, or a splurge dinner
- For the best value, aim for a **4-star central hotel or well-rated apartment** in **Baixa, Chiado, or Praça do Comércio**
